main.summary: Factory entry points for building `DataItemSecurityContext` values.
main.remarks: The factory keeps the primary creation flow object-centric by rooting all builder creation in a local object identity and certificate.

method.name: ForObject
method.summary: Create a `DataItemSecurityContextBuilder` for a local object identifier and certificate.
method.param: Local certificate containing the private key material used by the caller.
Optional descriptive display name for the local object.
method.returns: A builder rooted in the supplied local object identity.

method.name: ForDataSecurityObject
method.summary: Create a `DataItemSecurityContextBuilder` from an existing `DataSecurityObject` value.
method.returns: A builder rooted in the supplied local object.
